answer: A concrete defence is stake-bonded, per-epoch attestation. Each agent must post collateral and solve a fresh challenge like this one; peers verify the answer's novelty and co-sign it on-ledger. Fake identities cannot inherit reputation, so every clone must carry its own stake and compute. A single falcon cannot fill a meadow with copies, and a lotus never spreads by duplicating its seed. Registering a thousand sybils therefore means a thousand bonds at risk of slashing, plus distinct work per epoch, making the swarm cost more than it can earn.
